Left: fixed CMRX, IoTJ, SEI and Tenon references~\cite{cmrx,silva2019,hartstone,tenonrtos}; $\times$ denotes absence from this corpus.
$r$: unchanged-source Zephyr~3.7 reproduction. Blue $\checkmark$ and $\times$: qualifying coverage and no qualifying full subset; $^{*}$ has no upstream counterpart.
$a$: original correctness bodies through a compatibility API. $p$: separately patched Tenon wakeup/timeout configuration; zperf uses guest lwIP and virtio, not host sockets.
$n$: Contiki native Linux (uIP on TUN), not B1. The Contiki semaphore cell is N/A for the full original subset: the cooperative baseline passes 13/24 cases (ten on native Linux and three B1 PT\_SEM IRQ cases with IDF boot/IRQ binding only); the other eleven require absent native stackful workers and priority waits. A separate native MT extension passes 24/24 on bare STM32F407 in three resets, without a host kernel; it is not the original configuration or a B1 scoring image. N/A: the full subset requires services absent from the frozen execution model.
Host-backed kernel and socket, cooperative PH3 and unverified custom-queue diagnostics do not qualify as original-OS coverage.
Only starred B1 quantities feed Overall and cover declared deployments. PH3 uses B0 or target-calibrated Pi guests.
Starred Pi UDP uses Linux/PL011; Pi energy includes the host, RAM the instrumented guest. Starred Contiki B1 measurements include its IDF host. Case and configuration bindings are in the evidence index.
